description: Deletion requests and the account erasure workflow.
eraseDescription: This anonymizes the account and deletes its credentials, domains, and forms. It cannot be undone.
eraseErased: Erased: credentials, sessions, API keys, BYOK keys, settings, domains and forms.
eraseKept: Kept: audit log, subscriptions, and usage history survive erasure.
noPermission: You do not have permission to manage deletion requests.
reasonPlaceholder: Why are you taking this action?
reviewDescription: Approve to allow the erasure, or reject to close the request. Either way, a reason is required.
title: Security
